description: The correct parser should refuse with 'count_mismatch' if the number of results does not exactly match the number of articles, addressing the defect where spurious associations or padding occur. This is required by the expectations recorded in universal-refusal cases, e.g., observed-2026-09-02-002. Refusals with this kind are explicitly valid (see contract/types.py). All required contract functions must be defined inline.
